title: Drag and drop in the bag
about: Farm, day 9 at 10:00, seeds, a sprinkler and a scarecrow on the hotbar and goods in the bag. Open Menu > Bag: hold an item (or press and slide it) and drag it to another slot; a gold frame shows where it lands, a red one on a tool slot, where it cannot go. Drop it on a hotbar slot (the blue-edged row) to put it on the hotbar; drop it on a full slot to swap the two. A tap still picks an item and a second tap holds it.
